title: Dependency boundary: reference external packages; do not vendor the stack
summary: Native Database Backends intentionally vendors none of Database Core, Foreign Runtime, NoSQLServer, Alchemy Objects, Crypto, libpq or GIS runtime source/binaries. Runtime packages are resolved externally. This prevents stale embedded copies from shadowing canonical components and keeps backend qualification tied to exact companion versions.
invariants: Do not copy NoSQLServer, Database Core or Foreign Runtime source into the backend package.
Qualification records exact companion versions rather than assuming any newer package is compatible.
A newer roll-up component is available evidence, not automatic requalification of an older backend release.
Host libraries such as libpq remain external implementation requirements.
Transitive Alchemy/Crypto requirements belong to the selected external packages unless this component directly acquires such a dependency.

provenance.claim: Native Database Backends intentionally vendors none of its runtime/database dependencies and records exact qualification companions.
v0.2 explicitly states that NoSQLServer, Database Core, Foreign Runtime, Alchemy Objects, Crypto, libpq and GIS binaries/source are not vendored.
